false griefing reports
5 Mar, 2021 @ 10:40pm
Red Purger
I've seen a lot of overwatch cases where people are reported for griefing when they clearly aren't griefing. Cases range anywhere from "player built this item and now we are losing" to "this player isn't playing well and now we are losing"
So irritating to see. Please stop wasting your reports on this garbage. If they are actually griefing, doing stuff such as:
•AFK jungling and ignoring fights because they don't want to play and just want the game to end
•stealing or contesting farm with a core
•using items and abilities to get their teammate's killed or impairing their teammates (like cliffing teammates on purpose, IO relocate into the corner of the map)
•revealing location of wards, or revealing smokes/roshan of allied team to the enemy
•stealing lanes (offlaner pos 4 goes mid and just saps XP)
then report them. If they aren't doing the above, or some variation of the above, they probably aren't griefing, and you're just salty because you're losing.

Playing badly, or just being bad at the game, is not griefing. You know what IS griefing? Calling GG after one bad fight, and sitting in the fountain AFK until you lose, then reporting your teammate for griefing.
